guardrails: review_first is the default; no content is published before owner approval
do not fake, crawl, or scrape social platforms; use official APIs only
never expose tokens, OAuth secrets, OTPs, or sensitive PII in frontend, logs, or responses
all tenant data must be scoped by workspace_id
publish jobs must be idempotent; retries must not create duplicate posts
keep changes small, tested, and limited to the task scope
definition_of_done: code and relevant docs are updated
relevant lint/tests pass, or the reason they could not be run is documented
API authorization and tenant scope are tested when workspace data is touched
UI includes relevant loading, empty, error, permission, and responsive states
sensitive actions have audit/event logging where appropriate
no new dependency or abstraction is added without a clear boundary or bottleneck

tasks.title: Harden agent code execution and patch application
tasks.why: Real code-mode runs exposed two executor issues: malformed LLM diffs and valid diffs whose context does not apply to the current repo. The loop must be reliable before running larger feature batches.
acceptance_criteria: loop:code applies code changes and runs verify_commands when a patch is valid
Malformed or non-applicable patches keep the task pending instead of marking feature work failed
Patch failures include actionable diagnostics in roadmap/memory
The executor prefers structured patch lines or structured file edits over fragile raw multiline JSON strings
README documents that commit and push remain manual
tasks.prompt: Improve the agent-loop executor so code mode is dependable. Focus on patch parsing/application reliability, retryable task state, and clear diagnostics. Do not implement product features in this task.

tasks.title: Add CI for Gate A
tasks.why: ROADMAP Gate A is not met because lint, tests, build, and migration checks are still manual.
acceptance_criteria: GitHub Actions runs web lint, tests, and build
Backend ruff, pytest, and Alembic migration checks run with required services where appropriate
The workflow uses reasonable npm/uv caching without relying on local secrets
README or deployment docs describe what CI verifies
verify_commands: cd apps/backend && uv run ruff check .
tasks.prompt: Design and add a minimal Gate A CI workflow. Keep it simple for a solo-dev repo, but make sure it catches important regressions before pushing to dev.

tasks.title: Implement logout and refresh-session revocation
tasks.why: ROADMAP Week 4 and the baseline note that auth still lacks an explicit logout/revoke endpoint.
acceptance_criteria: There is an API endpoint to logout/revoke the current refresh token
A revoked refresh token cannot be exchanged for a new access token
Frontend sign out calls the API when a session exists and still clears local tokens if the API fails
No token is leaked in responses or logs
verify_commands: cd apps/backend && uv run pytest tests/test_auth_flow.py
tasks.prompt: Add logout/revoke-session support using the existing boundaries. Prefer the repository/service pattern, test backend behavior first, then wire the frontend sign-out path.

tasks.title: Add an email-provider boundary for OTP and password reset
tasks.why: Closed beta needs real email delivery; debug_code is only acceptable for local/debug mode.
acceptance_criteria: There is an email sender port and a fake/debug adapter for tests/local dev
Staging/production never return debug_code in API responses
Missing email-provider configuration fails clearly in staging/production
Docs list the required env vars and local behavior
verify_commands: cd apps/backend && uv run pytest tests/test_auth_flow.py
cd apps/backend && uv run ruff check .
tasks.prompt: Design a minimal email-provider boundary. A real vendor integration is optional if the vendor is not decided yet; the goal is to remove debug_code from production paths and clarify configuration.

tasks.title: Wire a basic brand-voice settings UI
tasks.why: Onboarding creates a brand profile, but the roadmap still lacks a way to edit brand voice/tone later.
acceptance_criteria: Users can view and edit basic brand name, industry, tone, and banned claims in Settings
Save has loading, error, and success states
Validation messages are short, clear, and user-facing
Frontend tests cover load, edit, and save error paths
tasks.prompt: Wire the Settings UI to the existing brand profile API. Keep the interface practical, work-focused, and consistent with the current components/styles.

tasks.title: Improve upload UX with progress, cancel, and preview
tasks.why: Week 5 notes that real uploads work, but progress percentage, mid-upload cancel, and image preview are missing.
acceptance_criteria: Image upload shows a local preview before creating a content job
Upload shows progress percentage and can be cancelled with AbortController
Upload errors include a clear next action
Image bytes still go directly to object storage, not through the backend API
tasks.prompt: Add upload progress, cancel, and preview to content creation while preserving the current direct-to-object-storage upload contract.

tasks.title: Add Content Engine tests for structured output and fake providers
tasks.why: Week 5 still lacks worker unit tests with fake providers and contract tests for malformed structured output.
acceptance_criteria: Malformed JSON/schema output causes provider fallback or job failure with a clear reason
Fake-provider tests do not call the network and do not require API keys
Banned claims are tested across uppercase and accent-insensitive variants
Token usage/event logging is not lost when a provider fails after consuming tokens
verify_commands: cd apps/backend && uv run pytest tests/test_content_flow.py tests/test_provider_router.py
cd apps/backend && uv run ruff check .
tasks.prompt: Expand Content Engine and output-validation tests based on the roadmap gaps. Prefer tests first; change implementation only when tests expose a real bug.

tasks.title: Add calendar UI for rescheduling posts
tasks.why: The backend has a reschedule API, but the roadmap notes that the calendar UI still lacks drag-and-drop or a change-time flow.
acceptance_criteria: Users can change date/time for valid scheduled or approved posts
Backend rejection is shown in UI and the calendar reloads/rolls back
Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh timezone behavior remains correct
Frontend tests cover success and 409 rejection
tasks.prompt: Add a post-rescheduling flow to the calendar. A modal/time input is acceptable instead of drag-and-drop if it reduces risk and preserves the real workflow.

tasks.title: Back the activity feed with real event/audit data
tasks.why: Week 8 still needs an activity feed sourced from audit/event projections that make sense to users.
acceptance_criteria: Dashboard activity feed is sourced from workspace-scoped event/audit data
Event copy is user-facing and does not expose technical detail or PII
Empty workspace state is handled
Tests cover backend tenant isolation and frontend loading/error/empty states
verify_commands: cd apps/backend && uv run pytest tests/test_analytics_flow.py
tasks.prompt: Design a small activity-feed projection from existing event_log/audit data. Reuse existing endpoints if sufficient; add a new endpoint only if the contract genuinely needs it.

tasks.title: Create a minimal internal operations metrics UI
tasks.why: The backend has /analytics/operations, but the roadmap still lacks an internal UI for debugging pilot operations.
acceptance_criteria: There is an internal route or section showing event/error rate, token totals, provider breakdown, publish success, and dead-letter rate
No secrets, PII, tokens, or request bodies are displayed
Loading, empty, and error states exist
Docs clarify that this is internal pilot/debug tooling
tasks.prompt: Wire a minimal internal UI to /analytics/operations. Prioritize pilot debugging usefulness over visual polish.

tasks.title: Add an E2E core flow from signup to publish to report
tasks.why: Gate E requires happy/error path E2E coverage on staging; there is still no signup -> draft -> approve -> publish -> report E2E flow.
acceptance_criteria: A local/staging runnable E2E happy path exists for the core value loop
Local E2E uses fake publisher and mock LLM so it does not spend money or publish real posts
The test creates isolated data and does not depend on old dev data
Docs explain how to run E2E and required infrastructure
tasks.prompt: Design the least brittle E2E core-flow test possible. If Playwright is needed, update package/docs and keep test data isolation explicit.

tasks.title: Write staging runbook and backup/restore rehearsal steps
tasks.why: Week 9/Gate E requires backup/restore, migration strategy, and an incident runbook before founder beta.
acceptance_criteria: Runbook lists the four required processes: web, API, worker, and beat
Checklist covers mock/fake/rate-limit flags that must not reach staging/production
Backup/restore rehearsal steps cover Postgres and object storage
Migration forward/rollback strategy is practical for a solo dev
verify_commands: cd apps/backend && uv run alembic check
tasks.prompt: Update staging/runbook docs for founder beta with concrete commands and checklists, not generic operations prose.

tasks.title: Complete security checklist for auth, tenant scope, upload, OAuth, and logs
tasks.why: Week 9 requires a security review of auth, tenant scope, upload, OAuth, secrets, and logs.
acceptance_criteria: Security checklist includes pass/fail status and evidence from tests/docs
Remaining gaps before customer beta are explicit
No secrets, keys, or tokens are copied into docs
If a small bug is found, it is fixed with a test
verify_commands: cd apps/backend && uv run pytest tests/test_auth_flow.py tests/test_connection_flow.py tests/test_token_crypto.py tests/test_media_flow.py
tasks.prompt: Create a security review checklist grounded in the current code and tests. If an important test gap is found, propose or add a small high-value test.

tasks.title: Set up visual regression and accessibility baseline
tasks.why: Gate B/test strategy still lacks visual regression, keyboard walkthrough, and automated accessibility checks.
acceptance_criteria: Baseline viewports include 360, 768, 1280, and 1440 for core screens
Automated accessibility checks cover at least the main auth/app routes
Docs explain how to update snapshots/baselines
CI is not made unreasonably slow before this becomes mandatory
tasks.prompt: Propose or set up a compact visual/a11y baseline. If new dependencies are too heavy, start with docs/checklists and explain the tradeoff.

tasks.title: Design data deletion, account deletion, and consent records
tasks.why: Gate F requires tested account/data deletion and consent records; Privacy mentions 30-day retention but code is not complete.
acceptance_criteria: There is a design for migration/API support for account deletion and data deletion
Hard delete, soft delete, and retention-queue data are clearly classified
Audit/log data needed for operations/legal reasons is not accidentally destroyed
If implemented, tenant scope and idempotency are tested
tasks.prompt: Start with a short design doc or a small implementation for deletion/consent. Balance privacy, auditability, and operations needs.

tasks.title: Prepare a 7-day founder dogfooding plan
tasks.why: Week 10/Gate E requires the founder to use the product for 7 days with at least 10 content jobs and 5 publish jobs.
acceptance_criteria: There is a 7-day daily checklist
There is a log template for activation, cost, latency, failed jobs, and support issues
P0/P1 criteria and triage flow are defined
Stop rules exist for duplicate publish, secret leak, or systemic publish failure
tasks.prompt: Write a practical founder-dogfooding plan that can be followed without reading source code. Prioritize a daily checklist and simple logging template.

tasks.title: Sync the product roadmap after an agent-loop batch
tasks.why: After agent-loop tasks are processed, docs/product/ROADMAP.md must remain the source of truth with updated status, verification evidence, and next steps.
acceptance_criteria: ROADMAP.md is updated only for tasks that are truly implemented, tested, or documented
Immediate backlog reflects the real remaining work after the batch
Related release gates include verification evidence or a clear reason they are not met
No [x] is added when the agent only proposed a plan without implementation
tasks.prompt: Read the agent-loop checkpoint and update docs/product/ROADMAP.md. Clearly distinguish implemented/tested work from mere agent proposals. After syncing, suggest the next 3 tasks that should enter the loop.
